title: Sync for iCloud
summary: Download and manage your iCloud contacts & calendars on any Android device.
description:
With Sync, you can manage your iCloud contacts and calendars on your Android device for free.

Features include:

* 2 way synchronization
* Connects directly to iCloud servers - no third party servers are used.
* Tutorial to log in with 2 step verification.
* App specific password can be generated without leaving the app.
* Background synchronization
* Multiple accounts
* Use your default calendar app to manage events


Setup only takes few steps. Calendars are synced to your default calendar on your phone / tablet. Contacts are synced to your default contacts app.

Data safety
The app transfers data directly between your device and Apple servers. We do not have access to your username/password.
